findings.title: `stash init` cannot complete without interactive, networked device login and a successful keyset bind
findings.label: valid
findings.note: authenticateStep runs first and always runs. login() has no error handling, bindDevice calls process.exit(1), and init only catches CancelledError, so any auth failure stops init before scaffolding.

findings.title: New guidance says no env vars are needed for local development, but `stash secrets` and LockContext still require them
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The README now says no env vars are needed, and the init next-steps dropped the CS_* instructions. But secrets getConfig still exits without CS_* (helpers.ts:33-51), and LockContext's loadWorkSpaceId still throws without CS_WORKSPACE_CRN or cipherstash.toml.

findings.title: Encryption() may fail after following the new 'no credentials' quick start if protect-ffi 0.21.0 does not read the device token
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The finding concedes that whether protect-ffi newClient reads auth.json is unknown. The failure mechanism is hypothetical and the cited code doesn't support it.

findings.title: Library consumers silently get older evlog and @byteslice/result versions with exact pins
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The exact pins and dependency downgrades are confirmed in package.json and the lockfile. The finding itself rates the impact low, and its mitigation (confirm intent) is reasonable.
